content:
The image shows a mango leaf with brown, necrotic lesions concentrated at the tip and margins. The damage is irregular and dry/brittle-looking, not sunken spots typical of anthracnose, not white powdery coating, and not sooty black encrustation. The tip dieback with browning spreading inward along the margins is characteristic of Die_Back disease.
